        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 3: Wait until the element with id 'message' has text, print it, and check that it contains the word 'success' (ignore upper/lower case)
    try:
        wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 10)
        message_element = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.ID, 'message') if d.find_element(By.ID, 'message').text.strip() else None)
        message_text = message_element.text
        print(message_text)
        if 'success' in message_text.lower():

        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 4: Close the browser at the end
    try:
        driver.quit()
        driver = None
    except Exception as e:

except Exception as e:
